topics.title: 课程作业与考核规范
topics.statusLabel: 默认允许用于教学支持
topics.summary: 阿尔托大学校级政策规定：除非任课教师明确另行规定，否则默认允许使用AI技术作为教学和学习的辅助支持。
topics.scope: 副校长批准的全校AI教学指引

claims.text: AI-based technologies are allowed as a support for teaching and learning unless instructed otherwise by the course teacher.

evidence.quote: The use of AI-based technologies is allowed as a support for teaching and learning unless instructed otherwise by the teacher of the course. The teacher of the course may decide on restrictions on the use of technology on a course- or task-specific basis if achieving the learning objectives of the course requires it.
evidence.title: Guidance for the use of AI in teaching and learning at Aalto University

topics.title: 考试与考场纪律
topics.statusLabel: 成熟度测试中的语言模型
topics.summary: 阿尔托大学指引将成熟度测试列为禁止使用语言模型的情形。
topics.scope: 成熟度考核与科目考场规程
topics.evidenceScope: Degree maturity tests and course exam restrictions

claims.text: Aalto guidance lists the maturity test among situations where language models may not be used.

evidence.quote: Situations where the use of language models is not allowed: maturity test.
evidence.title: Guidance for the use of AI in teaching and learning at Aalto University

topics.title: AI使用声明与披露
topics.summary: 若任课教师提出要求，学生须说明在学业任务中如何、使用了何种及/或为何使用AI技术。
topics.scope: 依教师要求强制说明使用情况

claims.text: Upon teacher request, students must describe how, what, and/or why AI-based technology was deployed in their learning task.

evidence.quote: Upon the teacher's request, the student is obligated to describe how, what and/or why AI-based technology has been used to do the learning task.
evidence.title: Guidance for the use of AI in teaching and learning at Aalto University

topics.title: 隐私与数据保护
topics.summary: 出于版权与隐私考量，教师仅可将学生作业提交至阿尔托大学批准的合规系统，或仅可在该类系统中要求学生提交作业。
topics.scope: 教师作业提交仅限校方审核系统
topics.evidenceScope: Teacher coursework submission in approved systems

claims.text: Teachers may only submit student work, or require students themselves to submit work, in systems approved by Aalto University for copyright and privacy reasons.

evidence.quote: The teacher may only submit student work or require students themselves to submit student work in systems approved by Aalto University, among other things, for copyright and privacy reasons.
evidence.title: Guidance for the use of AI in teaching and learning at Aalto University

topics.title: 认可与支持的AI工具
topics.summary: 阿尔托大学提供官方AI服务目录；保留的摘录未确立各产品的现行可用性或条款。
topics.scope: 阿尔托大学官方AI服务目录

claims.text: Aalto provides a directory of official AI services.

evidence.quote: The official AI services provided by Aalto University can be found at https://www.aalto.fi/en/services/ai-services.
evidence.title: Guidance for the use of AI in teaching and learning at Aalto University

topics.title: 科研与论文署名
topics.summary: 学生始终对提交作品负责；除非教师另有指示，语言模型可用于文本排版或构思，但不能将AI生成的文本原样作为本人书面回答。
topics.scope: 学术写作规范与个人完全作者责任

claims.text: Students are responsible for submitted work; language models can help with formatting or ideation unless the teacher instructs otherwise, but AI-generated text cannot be presented as is as the student’s own written response.

evidence.quote: The student is always responsible for the content of their submitted work. For example, language models can be used for formatting or ideation of the text produced, unless otherwise instructed by the teacher. However, AI-generated text cannot be presented as is as the student's own written response.
evidence.title: Guidance for the use of AI in teaching and learning at Aalto University

additionalTopics.title: 学术诚信与违规处理
additionalTopics.statusLabel: 违令使用按现行程序处理
additionalTopics.summary: 违背教师指示在学习任务中使用AI被视为作弊，并按现行程序处理。
additionalTopics.scope: 违背教师指示使用AI的作弊定性与现行程序
additionalTopics.evidenceScope: AI cheating definition and handling under current procedures

claims.text: Utilising AI in a learning task contrary to the teacher's instructions is considered cheating and handled in accordance with the current procedures.

evidence.quote: Utilising AI in a learning task contrary to the teacher's instructions will be considered cheating and will be handled in accordance with the current procedures.
evidence.title: Guidance for the use of AI in teaching and learning at Aalto University

additionalTopics.title: 教学实践原则
additionalTopics.summary: 教师若决定限制AI，必须在考核标准中明确说明限制条件，并合理把握通知时间以确保学生有充分可能按要求完成任务。
additionalTopics.scope: 考核设计与教师指引发布时效规范
additionalTopics.evidenceScope: Assessment design and instructor guidance timing

claims.text: Teachers deciding to restrict AI must provide clear instructions in assessment criteria and time guidance so students can complete tasks properly.

evidence.quote: If the teacher decides to restrict the use of AI on a course- or task-specific basis, they must provide clear instructions on the limitations in connection with the assessment criteria and time the guidance so that the student has the possibility to complete the task as instructed.
evidence.title: Guidance for the use of AI in teaching and learning at Aalto University

additionalTopics.title: 安全合规与采购
additionalTopics.statusLabel: 须经安全审查且免自费
additionalTopics.summary: 教师严禁强迫学生注册未经校方安全审查的外部系统或自费购买商业软件授权，维护学生平等与数据安全。
additionalTopics.scope: 校方安全审查与禁止自费硬性约束
additionalTopics.evidenceScope: Security check and financial equity requirements

claims.text: Teachers cannot require students to create accounts in unvetted systems or purchase software licenses, ensuring equality and security.

evidence.quote: The teacher cannot require the student to create an account in systems that have not been subjected to Aalto University's security check. When designing their course, the teacher must ensure that students are not put in an unequal position. This implies that the teacher cannot require the student to purchase licenses for systems.
evidence.title: Guidance for the use of AI in teaching and learning at Aalto University
evidence.location: Student equality and security check requirement
